descriptions.health_check: Check whether the Sybill API is reachable and responding. Takes no parameters. Returns a status object. Use this as a connectivity probe before running other commands, or to diagnose auth and reachability issues.
descriptions.rows_get: Fetch a single CRM row (a synced record such as a deal, contact, or account) by its id. Required: rowId (path). Returns the RowDetail with rowId, sourceId, objectTypeId, objectTypeName, remoteId, name, displayName, the row's fields map, and createdAt/updatedAt timestamps. Use this when you already have a rowId; use a list/search command to discover row ids first.
descriptions.sources_get: Fetch a single data source (a connected integration that feeds rows into Sybill) by its id. Required: sourceId (path). Returns the SourceResponse with id, name, displayName, and createdAt/updatedAt timestamps. Use this to resolve a sourceId returned by rows_get into a human-readable source name.
